description: Fetch room-level availability, pricing, and amenities for a specific hotel and stay dates.

currency.description: Currency to show prices in (ISO 4217, default: USD). Pass the user's local currency when you know it, e.g. GBP for a UK user or EUR for a user in Germany. Prices are converted from USD and are approximate; sorting and booking links are unaffected.

hotelId.description: Hotel ID (from search results) to fetch detailed availability for

live.description: Use live rates (includes booking links). Disable for faster, less accurate cached rates.

name: sk_hotel_details

bookingLink.description: Direct booking URL for this hotel

checkinDate.description: Check-in date for this detail search (YYYY-MM-DD)

checkoutDate.description: Check-out date for this detail search (YYYY-MM-DD)

hotelId.description: Skiplagged property identifier; not a user identifier

priceCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code of pricePerNightInDollars/totalPriceInDollars (USD when absent; may differ when the summary comes from a room quoted in another currency)

pricePerNightInDollars.description: Price per night in US dollars

pricing.description: Exchange rate for showing the USD prices above in another currency; the markdown output is already converted

approximate.description: True when prices were converted from USD; the final charge on the booking site may differ

currency.description: ISO 4217 code the prices are shown in

notice.description: Short note to relay to the user about the shown currency

rate.description: Units of `currency` per 1 USD used for conversion (1 for USD)

rateAsOf.description: When the server fetched the exchange rate (ISO datetime)

requestedCurrency.description: ISO 4217 code the caller asked for (may differ on fallback)

bookingLink.description: Direct booking URL for this room

id.description: Room offer identifier; not a user identifier

pricePerNightInDollars.description: Nightly price in US dollars for this room

taxesAndFeesInDollars.description: Portion of total that is taxes/fees in US dollars

totalPriceInDollars.description: Total stay price (room + taxes/fees) in US dollars
Total price for entire stay in US dollars

title: Skiplagged Hotel Details
